copy.text: You want investment tracking or tax preparation.

scenes.why: Every other ad promises more. Saying what it refuses to do is rarer, and it is in the listing because it is true.

caption.text: Import a bank statement, a note, or a CSV, and review what changed before it becomes part of your picture.

scenes.why: Then the positive case, on a real screen. Screen: "Records" (What's actually true right now, area by area: accounts, income, bills, subscriptions, transactions, debt.) chosen because it is the real screen closest to "Import a bank statement, a note, or a CSV, and review what changed before it bec"; focus on "Accounts".

copy.text: Your financial entries are private to your account.

scenes.why: The privacy line closes the trust argument.
The name lands on a film that has been honest with the viewer.
Instagram Reel rewards a direct close: the real price against the real list price.

reasoning.decision: Instagram Reel, 1080×1920, 12–26s, hook by 1.2s, sound on
reasoning.because: Full-screen and swipeable: the first second decides whether anyone stays. Mostly watched with sound, but captions still carry every point. The right edge holds like/comment buttons and the bottom holds the caption, so text lives in the middle band.

reasoning.decision: Personal Finance Companion: $49 (list $99), motif "index", calm personality, cool accent #0d3b2e
reasoning.because: From its definition and Shop listing. 4 real screens to show.

reasoning.decision: You have more than one account, bill, or income source and want them tracked in one real place, not five apps. / You want a next step handed to you, not a dashboard you have to interpret yourself every time.
reasoning.because: The listing's own audience lines; the director writes for them.

reasoning.decision: What it is not: Earn trust by stating what the product deliberately does not do, then show what it does instead.
reasoning.because: Best fit for a conversion film on Instagram Reel (platform fit 2, goal fit 3). Other candidates: What you get (6.1), Before and after (5.1).
A trust film: the listing's own boundaries, then the thing it does instead, then how it treats your data.

reasoning.decision: Transitions follow the product's own identity motif, "index"
reasoning.because: Transitions follow the product's own identity motif, "index": an index of tabs, so scenes slide in like the next tab.
Camera "float": a gentle float that keeps a held frame alive without demanding attention.
Grounds light → accent → light → ink: a cool accent, so a darker ground is used for contrast at a turn.
Sound-on placement: every transition, landing and reveal has a cue, and the bed ducks under the brand moment.
Each scene is held for the time its words take to read on Instagram Reel (0.26s a word), inside 12–26s.
